reply_text:
I replied to Dana in our DM: she should keep Tuesday 10 November at 14:30 free for the Brindle call.

That time comes from her own message to me on 14 October, where she said her standing call with the Tamsin Cold Chain team for the Brindle rollout had moved to Tuesdays at 14:30. I couldn't find a calendar invite for it, and nothing in the North team channels mentions it. So I told her to check that the time hasn't changed since then.
